Dostarlimab for dMMR/MSI-H Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer
headlines.summary: FDA granted accelerated approval to dostarlimab for adults with previously untreated Stage II/III dMMR or MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer. Patients with a clinical complete response can enter intensive non-operative surveillance, creating an approved immunotherapy-first organ-preservation pathway while confirmatory clinical benefit remains required.

headlines.title: ZZ-FIRST talazoparib plus enzalutamide in high-volume mHNPC
headlines.summary: The trial tests whether PARP inhibition adds value before castration resistance in a biomarker-unselected, high-volume population. Its randomized results caution against interpreting a single-arm PSA threshold as proof of comparative benefit and expose a substantial hematologic toxicity trade-off.
